**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION APPROVAL**

**Date:** May 5, 2025  
**Service:** Laparoscopic Sleeve Gastrectomy (CPT 43775)  
**Decision:** APPROVED

---

**Criteria Met:**

**BMI Requirement (≥35 kg/m²):** Met. Most recent BMI is 35.0 kg/m², documented on April 30, 2025 (doc-002).

**Obesity-Related Co-morbidity:** Met. Patient has documented active hyperlipidemia (E78.5) (cond-007) and type 2 diabetes mellitus (doc-003), both recognized obesity-related conditions.

**Prior Weight Management:** Met. Patient completed a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program including dietitian visits and phentermine trial, resulting in only 2 kg net weight loss that was subsequently regained. Program documented as unsuccessful (doc-004).

**Covered Procedure:** Met. Laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (CPT 43775) is a covered bariatric procedure.

This authorization is valid for 60 days from this letter. Please contact our office if you have questions or if the procedure date changes.
